title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along corridors in Calvin University’s practical off-campus orbit, each paired with one source-backed reason to stop.

cards.title: Fresh Thyme Market for Grocery Runs
cards.subtitle: Burton Street SE corridor
cards.notes: Follow Burton Street west from campus when you need produce, pantry goods, or another practical grocery stop near Calvin.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Burton Street grocery destination for everyday supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresh Thyme Market operates a grocery store at 2470 Burton Street SE in Grand Rapids.
cards.source_title: Grocery Store in Grand Rapids, MI | Fresh Thyme Market
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists daily hours of 7:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; verify before traveling.

cards.title: Breton Village for a Walkable Shop Cluster
cards.subtitle: Breton Road SE corridor
cards.notes: Turn onto Breton Road for an open-air center where multiple shops sit together along a walkable streetscape.
cards.short_summary: An open-air retail cluster organized around a walkable layout.
cards.evidence_claim: Breton Village is a 200,000-square-foot open-air center at 1814 Breton Road SE with a walkable streetscape and multiple retailers.
cards.access_notes: Individual tenant access and hours vary; consult the destination or tenant before visiting.

cards.title: D&W Fresh Market for Deli and Produce
cards.subtitle: Breton Road SE corridor
cards.notes: Use the Breton Road stop for a single errand spanning produce, bakery, deli, meat, seafood, and household groceries.
cards.short_summary: A full-service market with several fresh-food departments.
cards.evidence_claim: The D&W Fresh Market at 1814 Breton Road SE lists bakery, deli, produce, meat, and seafood departments.
cards.access_notes: The official store page lists daily hours of 6:00 a.m.–midnight; verify before traveling.

cards.title: Schuler Books for an Independent Bookstore Stop
cards.subtitle: 28th Street SE corridor
cards.notes: Head west on 28th Street to browse an independent bookseller instead of treating the corridor only as an errand route.
cards.short_summary: An independent bookstore directly on the 28th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan’s official tourism site identifies Schuler Books at 2660 28th Street SE as an independent bookseller.
cards.access_notes: Consult the bookstore for current public hours and event access before visiting.

cards.title: Woodland Mall for Many Shops in One Stop
cards.subtitle: 28th Street SE corridor
cards.notes: Continue along 28th Street when several shopping errands are easier to combine inside one named retail destination.
cards.short_summary: A multi-store shopping destination on the 28th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Woodland Mall’s official directory identifies the property as a shopping destination with multiple stores and dining options.
cards.access_notes: Mall and tenant hours can differ; check the official directory before traveling.

cards.title: Trader Joe’s for Pantry and Produce Shopping
cards.subtitle: 28th Street SE corridor
cards.notes: Follow 28th Street east for groceries, fresh produce, bakery goods, flowers, and everyday pantry basics in one trip.
cards.short_summary: A grocery stop on 28th Street with produce and everyday basics.
cards.evidence_claim: Trader Joe’s operates its Grand Rapids–Kentwood store at 3684 28th Street SE and lists produce, bakery items, flowers, and grocery basics.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists daily hours of 9:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; verify before traveling.

cards.entity_name: Kent District Library – East Grand Rapids Branch
cards.title: East Grand Rapids Branch for Study Facilities
cards.subtitle: Lakeside Drive SE corridor
cards.notes: Take Lakeside Drive to use public computers, private rooms, teen space, Wi-Fi, or the branch’s art-book collection.
cards.short_summary: A lakeside public library with study and technology facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The East Grand Rapids Branch at 746 Lakeside Drive SE provides private rooms, public computers, teen space, Wi-Fi, and an art-book collection.
cards.source_title: East Grand Rapids Branch | Kent District Library
cards.access_notes: The branch page lists current hours and dated closures; check it immediately before visiting.

cards.title: John Collins Park for a Lakeshore Pause
cards.subtitle: Lakeside Drive SE corridor
cards.notes: Stop along Lakeside Drive for the shore walk, overlook decks, benches, rain gardens, or a picnic beside Reeds Lake.
cards.short_summary: A lakefront park with overlooks, seating, and a shore walk.
cards.evidence_claim: John Collins Park on Lakeside Drive features a lakeshore walk, overlook decks, benches, rain gardens, picnic tables, and public restrooms.
cards.source_title: Parks, Trails & Reeds Lake | East Grand Rapids, MI
cards.access_notes: Public park rules apply; consult the city page and posted notices before using facilities.

cards.title: Reeds Lake Trail for a 4.2-Mile Loop
cards.subtitle: Reeds Lake Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the signed trail near Reeds Lake Boulevard for a paved walking, running, or cycling route through parks and wetlands.
cards.short_summary: A signed 4.2-mile route linking parks and natural areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The city documents Reeds Lake Trail as a 4.2-mile route using sidewalks, paved paths, and boardwalks for walkers, runners, and cyclists.
cards.source_title: Parks, Trails & Reeds Lake | East Grand Rapids, MI
cards.access_notes: Check city information, posted signs, weather, and trail conditions before starting the route.

cards.title: Meijer Gardens for Art and Horticulture
cards.subtitle: East Beltline Avenue NE corridor
cards.notes: Follow East Beltline north to combine outdoor sculpture and cultivated gardens at one clearly marked cultural destination.
cards.short_summary: A cultural stop combining sculpture displays with botanical gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan’s official tourism site places Frederik Meijer Gardens & Sculpture Park at 1000 East Beltline Avenue NE and describes its blend of art, culture, and nature.
cards.source_title: Frederik Meijer Gardens & Sculpture Park | Michigan
cards.access_notes: Admission is generally ticketed; check the venue for current hours, pricing, and exhibition access.
